name: QuickFile Accounting Software
description:
Query your QuickFile accounting records and run financial reports using natural language. Retrieve and filter invoices, analyse client and supplier trends, locate bank transactions and develop deep insights into the financial position of your business.

Claude connects to QuickFile with read-only access. Data retrieved from QuickFile is used only to respond to questions and is not stored between sessions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add QuickFile Accounting Software to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add QuickFile Accounting Software to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.quickfile.co.uk/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the QuickFile Accounting Software MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: QuickFile Accounting Software lists 22 MCP tools, including account_information, banks_balance_get, banks_list, banks_transactions, clients_contacts_get, clients_get, clients_list, invoices_get, invoices_list, journals_get, journals_list, and ledgers_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to QuickFile Accounting Software?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to QuickFile Accounting Software in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does QuickFile Accounting Software MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: QuickFile Accounting Software requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
QuickFile Accounting Software is developed by Quick File Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
